entries.notes: Branch feature/wireframe-creation (dev 7d2c2f41). Character creation is a W1 workspace: head with the title, the small portrait (sizing.headPortraitRem) and the exit; the kit’s categoryNav rail (a [Category ▾] selector on a compact host) listing Class, Character, Equipment and Review (behavior.categories); one active category in the pane, the others built once and kept off the document with their draft; a persistent footer of exactly two actions — Back (leaves on Class, steps back otherwise) and Next (refusing with the category’s unmet step) until Review, where Begin takes over. The attribute grid takes sizing.attributeColumnsWide columns from sizing.attributeNarrowBelowRem (the game’s 10 px rem) and the narrow count under it. Review carries the journey, the seed, the destination slot and the equipment summary. The list/grid switch is one small button in the head (only the active category’s shows); no “Choose” heads over the choice collections, no footer note, no “Class preview” eyebrow; choice descriptions clip to sizing.choiceDescriptionLines and, when the class list still runs past its box, fold to one line, then the preview column steps aside, then the descriptions go (behavior.fitChoicesToPane), so every class is in view without scrolling (owner, 2026-09-19). Deviations: the drawing’s categories (Class / Starting kit / Attributes / Review) are the game’s Class / Character / Equipment / Review; the per-section sub-steps (Standard/Assign points, keepsake, each hand) keep their in-pane Continues; inactive categories are built at mount and detached rather than never mounted; no paging (no collection exceeds five). tools/character-creation-check.mjs and tools/uniform-stat-foldouts.mjs still read the old .cz-flow fold and are owed a re-teach. Review round (QA agent, 2026-09-19): every spacing the W1c CSS block reads is a sizing key in creation.json projected by creationCssProperties (kit.css names no number for this screen); the rail is built from creationRailItems; a configured category the screen cannot draw throws at mount; a class pick re-runs the fit; the view switch names its views through creation.view.*; the catalogue (?shot=components) keeps its scrolling page and shows the live portrait as a specimen. Kept: the third fit rung (data-choice-fit="bare", descriptions hidden) — FRONTEND-WIREFRAMES W1c allows the pane to scroll, but the owner asked on 2026-09-19 for every class in view without scrolling; the rung is only reached when one-line descriptions with the preview column gone still overflow, and is the owner’s to drop. Unfold (owner, 2026-09-19, "why not do this"): behavior.classPreview "unfold" — no preview column; clicking a class opens its card to max(sizing.unfoldHeightVh, sizing.unfoldMinRem) with the portrait in sizing.unfoldPortraitShare of the width and the summary (starting resources, relic) in sizing.unfoldSummaryShare, nothing past the card (classUnfold in creationCards.js; the unfolded card is a two-row grid so the portrait is height-bound). The drawing’s 30vw / 70vw are read as shares of the card’s width: 100vw does not fit beside the rail. "column" keeps the old preview pane. Before a pick nothing unfolds (the pointer-follow has no column to draw in). Headless phone captures go through CDP device emulation (headless Chrome refuses windows under ~500 px), not tools/screenshot.mjs --viewport. Seen on the way: at ~600 px wide the categoryNav still chooses the rail and it squeezes to ~55 px with clipped labels — a categoryNav threshold, not this screen’s, owed a look.
